threshold_origin: Nested patient-level evaluation. Median selected threshold = 0.28.
purpose: Research fallback model for users with sparse/manual glucose history. Uses current BG plus approximately 15, 30 and 60-minute glucose anchors, recent carbs, recent bolus and time-of-day features.
limitations: The model was trained using CGM-derived HUPA-UCM samples, while manual BG readings may have different timing and measurement characteristics.
The model has relatively high recall but low precision and can generate false-positive risk warnings.
The model has not been clinically validated.
Predictions must not be used for autonomous insulin dosing or treatment decisions.
